native_mechanisms: One fold per mark, in strict order, each fold's angle set jointly by the mark and the crease left by the previous fold (state carried forward).
Every crease checked against all four wire-bird beaks simultaneously, refolded tighter until all four gauges agree, deliberately scrambling the spiral/snail markings so two piles can't line up alike.
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge down to one small dense coin-corner, discarding every sheet, scrap and failed gauge reading so nothing but the coin survives for comparison.
core_technique: Multiply-xor accumulation where each round's rotation amount is data-dependent (a = ((mark ^ state) & 31) + 16), run over four xxHash-style parallel lanes with distinct odd-prime multipliers, then rotate-summed and passed through a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer.
